changes.historical_text: Increase 1 face-up monster's DEF by 700 points until the end of this turn.
changes.summary: Era damage-step legality, no text difference: the goat script carries EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_CAL where the modern script carries EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP, moving the card's Damage Step activation window from the sub-steps before damage calculation (modern, PHASE_DAMAGE) to the damage-calculation sub-step itself (PHASE_DAMAGE_CAL). The other two diff lines are non-behavioural: the goat s.condition is the De Morgan equivalent of aux.StatChangeDamageStepCondition (utility.lua line 1413), and `RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END` is the literal expansion of RESETS_STANDARD_PHASE_END (constant.lua line 300). Chronology of this ruling is unresolved.

review.notes: The chain starts at lineage v2 (SYE-034, Starter Deck: Yugi Evolution, earliest tcg-eu 2004-03, month precision), carried exactly by both the goat cdb entry and the pinned modern cards.cdb, so no text transition is recorded. The lineage oscillates cosmetically between 'Increase 1 monster's DEF by 700 points during the turn this card is activated' (v1 MRL-E044, 2002-09-16; v3 SRL-044, Legendary Collection, 2010) and the v2 'face-up ... until the end of this turn' wording (v4 SRL-EN044, Spell Ruler 25th Anniversary Edition, 2023); same resolution throughout. Identical mechanism to Snake Fang (504700002) - see that record for the corroborating flag-usage counts across the goat and official script sets, and for why this is ruling rather than engine (the activation window is per-card script data, not something a rule profile can rewrite).
